title: My Pack!
description: Joke resource pack that changes some textures.
body:
Joke resource pack that changes some textures.
![Upper iron door texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/427b5dc58f0e869fccc18ed07ac0d6fa04f0e568.png)
The iron doors window looks like iron bars.

I'd say it's good for pvp because of the short swords.
![Short swords](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02c7af215713138400e505eeea2aa9bfd26a0c2a.png)

![Simple light](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd4d7a5b7f4cefbb47687e0888bc5ee9bb0d9188.png)
Very simple lights.

![Better concrete](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a6eb09999bdd0773cc34b1fa7e4e26896aedeb9.png)
And simplistic concrete thats better for redstone! (pretty hard to see)
